commands.name: apply
commands.summary: Apply JSON mutations to a project
commands.blurb: Reads a JSON array of operations from stdin and applies them in order.

flags.summary: validate the operations without writing anything
read operations from a file instead of stdin
print the operation contract as JSON and exit

See each sub-command's help for details on how to use the generated script.

commands.name: export
commands.summary: Dump a map as Markdown or JSON-LD
commands.blurb:
Traverses the map along IBIS relationships and writes it out for
downstream processing — the post-computation half of the AI loop.

flags.summary: map to export (defaults to the most recent)
write to a file instead of stdout

commands.name: grammar
commands.summary: Print the IBIS edge rules this binary enforces
commands.blurb:
Prints the legal node types and relationships. Point an AI agent at
`dialogmapper grammar --json` so it can construct valid edges instead
of guessing and retrying.

commands.name: help
commands.blurb:
Help provides help for any command in the application.
Simply type dialogmapper help [path to command] for full details.

commands.name: init
commands.summary: Initialize a dialogmapper project in the current directory
commands.blurb:
Creates maps.db, an .assets directory for local images, and starter
AGENTS.md and README.md files.

flags.summary: rewrite the generated AGENTS.md and README.md; never touches your maps
name of the first map (default "Untitled Map")

subcommands.name: clear
subcommands.summary: Remove every node from a map, keeping the map

subcommands.name: list
subcommands.summary: List the maps in this project

subcommands.name: add
subcommands.summary: Add a node, optionally attached to an existing one

flags.summary: map name or id (optional when the project has one map)
id of the node to attach to
relationship to the parent; inferred when omitted
question, idea, pro, con, note or map
change the node's type; its links are relabelled to match

subcommands.name: rm
subcommands.summary: Delete a node everywhere, or remove it from one map

flags.summary: remove from this map only, keeping the node elsewhere

commands.name: redo
commands.summary: Reapply the last change undone from the command line
commands.blurb: Reapply the last change undone from the command line

commands.name: seed
commands.summary: Scaffold a map from a research document
commands.blurb:
Reads a markdown or text file and populates the database with IBIS
scaffolding, so a deliberation can start from existing material instead of a
blank canvas.

flags.summary: markdown or text file to scaffold from, or - for stdin
print the planned structure without writing
name for the map to create (defaults to the file name)
seed into an existing map instead of creating one

commands.name: start
commands.summary: Serve the dialog mapping UI on localhost
commands.blurb:
Starts the local HTTP and WebSocket server and serves the embedded
frontend. Desktop browsers get the canvas; phones get a linear capture view.

flags.summary: interface to bind; use 127.0.0.1 to keep the map to this machine only (default "0.0.0.0")
do not print the QR code on startup
serve to the network without an access key (anyone who can reach the port can edit)
do not contact github.com to look for a newer release
open the map in your default browser
port to listen on (0 picks a free one) (default 7373)

commands.name: undo
commands.summary: Reverse the last change made from the command line
commands.blurb:
Reverses changes recorded under the CLI's own undo history — most
usefully, an entire `dialogmapper seed` run.

commands.name: upgrade
commands.summary: Replace this binary with the latest release
commands.blurb:
Downloads the published build for this platform and replaces the running
binary with it. No Go toolchain required.

flags.summary: report what would be installed and stop
do not ask before replacing the binary
